group_name: Community Drum Class with Larry McDowell
summary: A free, drop-in hand-drumming class taught weekly (Mondays) by instructor Larry McDowell at The Well, a West Asheville community event space. It is explicitly framed as beginner/intermediate friendly with no experience necessary and shared drums provided, not a membership-based community; only the instructor and venue recur.

evidence.note: Both units are tagged 'Beginner Friendly' / 'All Levels' / 'Education' and every listing summary describes it as a class ('Hands-on community drumming led by Larry McDowell... builds timing, groove, and group cohesion'), with no mention of named regulars, membership, or sign-up.

No description text is provided on any of the 24 combined listings across the two units, only short AI-style summaries; no links to a Facebook group, Meetup, Discord, or newsletter appear anywhere in the records.

The Well's own event page describes it as a free community class taught by Larry McDowell ('has been teaching hand drumming in the Asheville area for decades'), drop-in with 'no experience necessary,' donations optional, and no registration or membership process mentioned.
Third-party events listing independently confirms the recurring weekly class format tied to the instructor and venue, consistent with a taught class rather than a self-organized group.
